title: Train to Busan
short: Three films, one an animated prequel
blurb: A zombie outbreak on a high-speed train, an animated prequel showing how it began in Seoul, and a sequel four years later.

seoul16.set: The night before Train to Busan

note: Seoul Station is an animated prequel by the same director, set the night before Train to Busan, and it is much bleaker. Peninsula is set in the same world four years on with a new cast.
